headline: Serbia Central Bank Revokes License of Alta Bank
summary: Serbia’s central bank revoked the license of Alta Bank on October 31. The bank's owner was reportedly tied to the party of former president Aleksandar Vucic.
why: Central bank regulatory actions directly affect the operations and market access of domestic commercial banks, impacting the local financial sector stability.

impacts.name: Serbia
impacts.why: Revocation of a bank license affects the domestic banking sector stability.
